messages:
Sana (partnerships): FYI vendor roadmapping call recap: Nvidia indicated staggered H100/H200 stock with a microcode refresh pushing some H200 knobs. Need marketplace messaging + SI handshake. Ian, what's the minimal driver/firmware?
Ian (hw-eng): Short: FW 1.3.0 preferred (from 1.2.x). Driver baseline 525.7+. A handful of H200 SKUs require the bump; H100 mostly fine. I'll drop the SKU matrix into drive.
Kei (platform): Plan: build a canary image tag `redwood/gpu:hw-wedge-2026-03-canary`, add routing rule to prefer fw>=1.3.0. Schedule canary 2026-03-30 02:00 UTC.
Devon (sre): Note from Gaudi tests: thermal derate at sustained high TDP. For the canary we'll limit concurrent slots per-node 8->6 and enable throttling policy. Rollback criteria: >5% error rate or tail latency spike >25%.
Lena (product): I'll prepare partner-facing language: staggered availability, driver notes, and suggested integration windows. Send to #partners-docs for signoff.
ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: mw-canary v2 -> 2026-03-30T02:00:00Z.
Sana (partnerships): Actions: Ian publish SKU-driver matrix; Kei push canary + telemetry tag `preannounce_wedge:2026-03`; Devon finalize rollback thresholds; Lena ship partner note. Ping when done. :raised_hands:
